thread:
devon_ae: FYI — AcmeCo signed LOI, they're asking for EU data residency clause in our DPA and want MSA redlines. Need path to exec signature and procurement timeline. PO target EOW. Can someone advise?

sara_sales: Nice, congrats. Which region are they insisting on? Frankfurt or Amsterdam?

devon_ae: Frankfurt only. Also they've requested 12-month minimum commitment + POC discount + SOC2 attestations attached.

ana_procurement: We should confirm if they need data at rest + in transit residency or just processing location. Also what billing entity for the PO?

mike_legal: Pinged. We need the customer's proposed redline set. Can they accept our DPA v3 with an addendum rather than full contract rewrite? If they want residence in EU maybe we add a data transfer addendum.

devon_ae: They've pushed back — legal sent over 6 redlines, main ask is 'Data Storage Location: all backups and logs to be stored within EU.' They also want HSM/KMS key control language.

mike_legal: Paste of problematic clause:
```text
"All backups, logs, and derivative data shall be stored and processed exclusively within the European Economic Area (EEA)."
```
This is risky for our hosted model unless we use dedicated capacity. Options: (1) Offer Dedicated or Private, (2) carve out logs/telemetry with pseudonymization, (3) contractual S3 location commitment for backup only.

sara_sales: Customer preferred hosted but open to Dedicated if price comps. Devon — can you get them to confirm whether Dedicated is acceptable? We can prepare pricing delta.

tom_finance: If they go Dedicated, finance needs a billing entity: AcmeCo EU invoicing required? Also lead time for committed GPUs is 6 weeks.

ana_procurement: For signature routing: do they accept DocuSign? Are we sending our MSA or theirs?

devon_ae: They provided their MSA with redlines. They will accept DocuSign. They asked for exec-level signature on MSA + PO from procurement.

mike_legal: Alright — legal can propose these responses: (a) Accept storage in EU for customer data + backups for Dedicated deployments only; (b) For hosted, commit to EU region processing but reserve right to route logs outside EEA for ops with strict pseudonymization; (c) KMS/HSM: support BYOK for Dedicated/Private; hosted gets managed keys with SOC2 attestation.

devon_ae: I'll present options to customer — need pricing delta and a sample redline response. Sara, Tom can you prepare numbers?

sara_sales: On it. I'll prepare a draft order form with two SKUs: Hosted (standard) and Dedicated (EU-resident). ETA tomorrow morning.

tom_finance: Also need PO template + tax details. If they want monthly billing instead of annual, margin changes.

mike_legal: I'll draft a short 'we can accept with these conditions' redline and upload. contracts_bot: create thread and attach versioned DPA response pls.

contracts_bot: Created doc 'AcmeCo_DPA_Response_v1' and uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/acme/dpa_response_v1

devon_ae: Great — thanks everyone. I'll update after customer call at 15:00 CET. :thumbsup:
